title: The Best Cap Table Software for Canadian Startups (2027)
summary: Compare cap table software for Canadian startups on CCPC support, cost as you grow, and Delaware flip readiness. Pricing for Mantle, Carta, and Cake.
body_markdown:
Choosing cap table software as a Canadian founder comes down to three questions. Does it handle Canadian corporations natively? Will the price climb every time you grant options? And will it still work if you flip to Delaware or hire in the US?


We compared the three platforms Canadian startups ask about most. Full disclosure: we’re from Mantle. We’ve used each vendor’s published pricing and called out where a competitor is the better fit.


### Our picks at a glance:


- **Best overall for Canadian startups:[Mantle](https://withmantle.com/equity/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=best-cap-table-software-canada)**


- Built in Toronto, supports Canadian and US corporations, unlimited stakeholders on every plan, and a free plan with no stakeholder cap.


- **Best for complex, later-stage companies: Carta**


- Advanced enterprise tiers priced for companies that can afford quote-based, per-stakeholder pricing.


- **Best for quarterly billing: Cake**


- Operates across Australia, the US, the UK, India, and Singapore, with quarterly billing on its entry plan, but costs $60 a year per stakeholder past your limit.


---


### How we evaluated each platform


We scored each platform on what matters most to a Canadian startup between incorporation and Series B.


1. **Canadian corporation support:** Does it support Canadian corporations directly, and does it offer anything for CCPC status?
2. **Real cost as you grow:** We looked past the entry price to what happens at 30, 60, and 100 stakeholders. Canadian startups often grant options broadly, so per-stakeholder pricing adds up fast.
3. **Cross-border readiness:** Can it handle both Canadian and US entities if you flip to Delaware, and does it offer 409A valuations for US hires?
4. **Setup and support:** Who builds your cap table, how long it takes, and whether it costs extra.
5. **Data portability:** Can you export in the Open Cap Table Format (OCX) and leave without rebuilding your records?

---


### Mantle Equity: Best overall for Canadian startups


#### Built for Canadian and US corporations


[Mantle](https://withmantle.com/equity/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=best-cap-table-software-canada) supports both Canadian and US corporations on the same platform. If you plan to flip to Delaware later, your history stays in one system before and after the flip. For US hires, Growth includes an annual 409A valuation, so your US option holders have the documentation they need.


#### CCPC Support on Growth+ plans


Canadian-controlled private corporation (CCPC) status affects how your employees’ stock options are taxed and which tax credits your company can claim.[Mantle’s Growth+ plan](https://withmantle.com/pricing/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=best-cap-table-software-canada) include CCPC support, so you can keep an eye on your status as you raise money and bring on US investors.


#### Flat pricing that doesn’t penalize hiring


Every Mantle plan includes unlimited stakeholders. Granting options to your whole team doesn’t raise your bill, and you won’t be forced to upgrade because your headcount or funding grew.


#### Setup done for you


On paid plans, Mantle’s team builds your cap table from your existing documents, such as SAFEs, share certificates, and option grants. You review the draft, and the team handles the rest. Most cap tables are set up in 5-7 business days.


#### AI built in


[Mantle Clerk](https://withmantle.com/equity/ai-for-founders/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=best-cap-table-software-canada) is a built-in AI assistant for everyday equity tasks. The[Mantle Equity connector for Claude (MCP)](https://withmantle.com/docs/mantle-equity-mcp/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=best-cap-table-software-canada) lets you ask questions about your live cap table in Claude. AI workflows like AI Extract and AI Draft handle the busywork: AI Extract builds your cap table straight from your SAFEs, grants, and share certificates.


#### Open format, no lock-in


Exports use the[Open Cap Table Format (OCX)](https://blog.withmantle.com/a-guide-to-open-cap-table-format//?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=best-cap-table-software-canada) . You can leave whenever you want without losing your records.


**Best for:** Canadian startups from incorporation to Series C+ that want predictable pricing and a platform built around Canadian companies.


---


### Carta: best for later-stage companies with the budget for it


### Platform Breadth


Carta’s advantage is breadth beyond the cap table. Later-stage companies get[Total Compensation](https://carta.com/blog/category/compensation/) , which benchmarks salary and equity against peer companies, built with Sequoia. Carta Law offers legal services alongside the platform. Carta also supports LLCs, and it runs fund administration for many VCs, so your investors may already manage their portfolios inside Carta. Add transfer agent services, and it’s built for companies with a dedicated equity team and the budget to use it all.


### Pricing


Free for up to 25 stakeholders. Paid plans are quoted by sales as a minimum annual fee plus a per-stakeholder price. Late-stage pricing is customized to cap table size, transaction volume, and service level, and services like 409As can be sold as add-ons.


**Watch out for:** For early-stage Canadian startups, Carta is usually more platform and more cost than you need. You can’t budget without a sales call, your bill grows with every hire, and onboarding fees may apply. It’s also built around US companies first.


**Best for:** mature, later-stage companies with large cap tables, a dedicated finance or equity team, and the budget for enterprise pricing.


---


### Cake: Best for teams that want to pay quarterly


#### Quarterly billing


Cake’s standout is billing flexibility. Its Build plan can be paid quarterly instead of up front for the year, which spreads the cost for teams watching every month of runway.


### Pricing


Build is $1,000 a year for 25 stakeholders, billed annually or quarterly. Annual billing is cheaper, saving up to 33%, so paying quarterly costs more over the year. Team is $2,750 a year for 40 stakeholders and includes a 409A. Past each limit, every stakeholder adds $60 a year. The free plan covers up to 5 stakeholders.


**Watch out for:** The free plan ends at 5 stakeholders, and per-stakeholder pricing adds up once you start hiring. Cake was built in Australia, and when it[raised its seed round in 2022](https://www.startupdaily.net/2022/03/startup-stakeholder-management-platform-cake-equity-raises-3-million-seed-round/) , it listed Australia, the US, the UK, India, and Singapore as its markets. Canada wasn’t on that list.


**Best for:** small teams that would rather pay quarterly than annually, and expect to stay under 25 stakeholders.


---


### Switching platforms: what to expect


Moving your cap table is less work than most founders expect. Here’s how it works on Mantle:


1. **Gather your documents:** Share certificates, SAFEs, option grants, and board approvals, or export your current cap table.
2. **Upload them:** On the free Starter plan, AI Extract reads your documents and builds the cap table. On paid plans, Mantle’s team build your cap table for you.
3. **Review the draft:** Mantle flags gaps and inconsistencies so you can fix them before diligence.
4. **Publish and invite:** Add your team, investors, and law firm.


For early-stage startups, self-serve setup can be as quick as a single afternoon. Larger cap tables with concierge onboarding and migration are typically set up in 5-7 business days. Mantle has a step-by-step guide for[migrating from Carta](https://withmantle.com/docs/migrate-from-carta) .


---


### FAQ


#### What is the best cap table software for Canadian startups?


Mantle is the best choice for most Canadian startups. It’s headquartered in Toronto, supports Canadian and US corporations, includes unlimited stakeholders on every plan, and offers a free Starter plan.


#### Is there free cap table software for Canadian startups?


Yes. Mantle Starter is free with unlimited stakeholders, and includes free SAFE issuance, e-signing, and reporting.


#### Does Carta work for Canadian companies?


Carta is used by many companies outside the US, but it’s built around US companies first and quotes paid pricing through sales. Ask how it handles Canadian corporations and CCPC status before you sign.


#### Do I need different cap table software after a Delaware flip?


Not if your platform supports both Canadian and US corporations. Mantle does, so your records stay in one place before and after the flip.


#### How much does cap table software cost for a Canadian startup?


Most platforms price in US dollars. Early-stage startups can often start at $0 on a free plan. Paid plans typically range from about $1,000 to $3,000 a year, depending on whether you need concierge setup or a 409A valuation.


#### Does Mantle do a 409A valuation?


Yes. Growth includes an annual 409A valuation, which helps US option holders avoid tax penalties.


---


### The bottom line


Most cap table software was built for Delaware first. Mantle was built in Toronto for Canadian founders like you. It supports Canadian and US corporations, has flat pricing that never charges you for hiring, and is ready for a flip or your first US hire.


Start free with unlimited stakeholders, or compare plans at[withmantle.com/pricing](http://withmantle.com/pricing) .
